title: Stavropolous River
summary: The Stavropolous River is located in Velo, Greece. Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, and Zhalia Moon travelled whilst searching the Argo and its treasures including the Hoplite Titans of Jason. Whilst diving down to investigate the ship, Lok nearly drowned after his air tank was cut off. It turned out that the Argo was not sunk here but that the ship belonged to Atalanta, one of the bravest of the Argonauts.

The '''Stavropolous River''' is located in [[Velo, Greece]]. [[Dante Vale]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Lok Lambert]], and [[Zhalia Moon]] travelled whilst searching the [[Argo]] and its treasures including the [[Hoplite]] [[Titans]] of [[Jason]]. Whilst diving down to investigate the ship, Lok nearly drowned after his air tank was cut off. It turned out that the Argo was not sunk here but that the ship belonged to [[Atalanta]], one of the bravest of the Argonauts. {{source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

==Trivia==
* The Stavropolous River does not exist in real life. However, there exists a city in Grece going by the name Stavroupoli.
